```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(r5r)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)
```

```{r }
r5r_core <- r5r::build_network(data_path = "./DATA")
```


```{r }
schools_sf    <- readRDS("./DATA/schools_sf.rds")
csa_centroids <- readRDS("./DATA/csa_centroids.rds")

#CSA centroids
origins <- csa_centroids %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(
    id  = as.character(SA_PUB2022),
    lon = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
    lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(id, lon, lat)

#weighted by number of places
destinations <- schools_sf %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(
    id  = as.character(roll_number),
    lon = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
    lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(id, lon, lat, places)

# Urban/Rural
urb_rural_df <- read_csv("D:/Final-Project/DATA/SAPS_2022_Small_Area_UR_171024.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    category = str_extract(UR_Category_Desc, "(?<=\\.).*"),
    urban_rural = case_when(
      category %in% c(" Cities"," Satellite Urban Towns"," Independent urban towns") ~ "Urban",
      category %in% c(" Rural areas with high urban influence"," Rural areas with moderate urban influence"," Highly rural/remote areas") ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(id = GEOGID) %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
  select(id, urban_rural) %>%
  distinct()

#filter Urban
origins_urban <- origins %>%
  left_join(urb_rural_df, by = "id") %>%
  filter(urban_rural == "Urban") %>%
  select(id, lon, lat)

cat("Total CSAs:", nrow(origins), "\n")
cat("Urban CSAs only:", nrow(origins_urban), "\n")
cat("Destinations (Schools):", nrow(destinations), "\n")
```

```{r }
# Walking accessibility
# cutoffs 6 time thresholds

access_walk <- r5r::accessibility(
  r5r_core               = r5r_core,
  origins                = origins_urban,
  destinations           = destinations,
  opportunities_colnames = "places",
  mode                   = "WALK",
  max_walk_time          = 30,
  decay_function         = "exponential",
  cutoffs                = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30)
)

saveRDS(access_walk, "./DATA/access_walk_urban.rds")
cat("Walking rows:", nrow(access_walk), "\n")
head(access_walk)
summary(access_walk$accessibility)
```

```{r }
# Cycling accessibility

access_cycle <- r5r::accessibility(
  r5r_core               = r5r_core,
  origins                = origins_urban,   
  destinations           = destinations,
  opportunities_colnames = "places",        
  mode                   = "BICYCLE",
  max_trip_duration      = 20,
  decay_function         = "exponential",
  cutoffs                = c(5, 10, 15, 20)
)

saveRDS(access_cycle, "./DATA/access_cycle_urban.rds")
cat("Cycling rows:", nrow(access_cycle), "\n")
head(access_cycle)
summary(access_cycle$accessibility)
```

```{r }
saps <- read_csv("D:/Final-Project/DATA/SAPS_2022_Small_Area_UR_171024.csv") %>%
  filter(T1_1AGETT <= 950) %>%
  mutate(
    SA_PUB2022 = as.character(GEOGID),
    school_age_pop = rowSums(
      across(c(T1_1AGE4T, T1_1AGE5T, T1_1AGE6T,
               T1_1AGE7T, T1_1AGE8T, T1_1AGE9T,
               T1_1AGE10T, T1_1AGE11T, T1_1AGE12T,
               T1_1AGE13T, T1_1AGE14T, T1_1AGE15T,
               T1_1AGE16T, T1_1AGE17T, T1_1AGE18T)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, school_age_pop)

access_walk_norm <- access_walk %>%
  filter(cutoff == 30) %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
  left_join(saps, by = c("id" = "SA_PUB2022")) %>%
  mutate(
    access_walk_per100 = ifelse(
      school_age_pop > 0,
      100 * accessibility / school_age_pop,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

access_cycle_norm <- access_cycle %>%
  filter(cutoff == 20) %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
  left_join(saps, by = c("id" = "SA_PUB2022")) %>%
  mutate(
    access_cycle_per100 = ifelse(
      school_age_pop > 0,
      100 * accessibility / school_age_pop,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

saveRDS(access_walk_norm,  "./DATA/access_walk_urban_norm.rds")
saveRDS(access_cycle_norm, "./DATA/access_cycle_urban_norm.rds")

cat("Walk normalised rows:", nrow(access_walk_norm), "\n")
cat("Cycle normalised rows:", nrow(access_cycle_norm), "\n")
```

```{r histograms, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
p_walk <- ggplot(
  access_walk_norm %>% filter(accessibility > 0),
  aes(x = accessibility + 1)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "lightblue", colour = "white") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Walking accessibility - Urban CSAs",
    x = "Weighted school places reachable",
    y = "Number of CSAs"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_cycle <- ggplot(
  access_cycle_norm %>% filter(accessibility > 0),
  aes(x = accessibility + 1)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "lightblue", colour = "white") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Cycling accessibility - Urban CSAs",
    x = "Weighted school places reachable",
    y = "Number of CSAs"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

p_walk + p_cycle
```

r5r::stop_r5(r5r_core)
